name: Joseph of Nazareth
title: Jesus' foster father
summary: Joseph was a righteous carpenter from Nazareth and Mary's fiancé. When he discovered that Mary was pregnant, he intended to divorce her quietly, but an angel explained that the child was conceived by the Holy Spirit. Joseph took Mary as his wife, protected the family during their flight to Egypt, and raised Jesus.

keyEvents.title: The angel's message in a dream
keyEvents.description: An angel appeared to Joseph in a dream and explained that Mary's child was conceived by the Holy Spirit. He was to name him Jesus.

keyEvents.title: The journey to Bethlehem
keyEvents.description: Joseph took Mary to Bethlehem for the census, and there she gave birth to Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Flight to Egypt
keyEvents.description: An angel warned Joseph in a dream about Herod's plans. Joseph fled with his family to Egypt during the night.

keyEvents.title: Return to Nazareth
keyEvents.description: After Herod died, an angel directed Joseph to return, and the family settled in Nazareth.

keyEvents.title: Jesus in the temple
keyEvents.description: Joseph and Mary searched for the 12-year-old Jesus for three days and found him in the temple among the teachers.
